_meta.notes: This copy uses the SHORT cover variant headed '[Officeholders - Year-End]' that carries ONLY the Type-of-Report and Report-Verification blocks — there are no candidate/party/office/district fields on the sheet at all, so those are null (field absent), not blank. The candidate name comes from the printed verification line ('Jennifer Wilson') and the Summary Page header ('Wilson'). June 17 interim checked; neither amendment box checked; signed 6/17/14, received JUN 17 2014. Line 3 (9,021.97) carries forward from the AMENDED April report (key 5cfe4be1), not the original.

contributions.detail: exact (41952.53 = 41,952.53); 77 rows across the two attachment pages sum to the attachment's own printed 'TOTAL: $41,952.53', which equals Summary line 1 Column A 41,952.53

expenditures.detail: exact (17278.12 = 17,278.12); 61 rows sum to the attachment's own printed underlined total 17,278.12, which equals Summary line 2 Column A 17,278.12

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NEITHER form schedule page prints a subtotal: p3 (Itemized Contributions Received) and p6 (Itemized Expenditures Made) both carry only the words 'See attached' and leave BOTH the 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' and the grand-total cells EMPTY (verified by 200 dpi crops of those cells). The gates are therefore the attachments' own totals: p4+p5 rows = 41,952.53 = printed TOTAL (p4 alone = 11,007.76, p5 alone = 30,944.77, and p4 prints no running subtotal because the table continues); p7 rows = 17,278.12 = printed total. Both gate exactly. Balance chain on p2 also closes: line 3 9,021.97 + line 4 41,952.53 = line 5 50,974.50; line 5 - line 6 17,278.12 = line 7 33,696.38.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 and p5 are LANDSCAPE and were rendered at 300 dpi and rotated 90 CW (a CCW test render came out upside down); each was then read as four full-width horizontal band crops rather than as a whole rotated page, because a whole page downsamples 40 rows below reading size. p7 is PORTRAIT but 61 rows long and was read as three full-width band crops at 300 dpi. Row geometry for p4/p5 was taken from machine-detected table rule lines rather than eyeballed, then converted back to portrait page percentages.
itemized.notes: FORM VARIANT: '2014 Financial Disclosure Report For County and Local School Board Candidates [Officeholders - Year-End]' - schedules titled 'Itemized Contributions Received' / 'Itemized Expenditures Made', Summary Column B headed 'Year to Date'. Cover checks INTERIM / June 17 'For the period ending June 16, 2014'; signed 6/17/14; clerk stamp RECEIVED IN OFFICE JUN 17 2014 - agrees with the chunk listing. All money detail is on three typed attachments; the two form schedule pages say only 'See attached'. PRIVACY: on the contributions attachment the Street column is a black county redaction block, but City / State / Zip are printed in the clear, so donor_city and donor_state ARE recorded here (zip is deliberately not carried - there is no field for it and it is part of the address). ONE EXCEPTION worth flagging to a human: on the last real donor row (Arbor Park Commercial Properties, LLC, 6/16/14) the redaction bar stops short and a street address is partially visible in the source; it has not been transcribed into any field or note. The contributions sheet ends with a filer AGGREGATE line - '22 donors at $50 or less - aggregate', $910.00, no date - emitted as one row with a blank date and needs_review=1, since it is not a donor. Two rows carry the sheet's own 'in-kind' x (Dave Jones 138.17 and Bruce and Nancy Baird 444.59 on p4; Price Realty Group, LLC 2,474.77 on p5 - three rows in total) and all three are inside the printed total. Note also that the candidate appears on her own expenditure list twice, as 'Jenny Wilson' (repay personal loan 500.00) and 'Jennifer Wilson' (reimburse for office supplies 289.23) - two spellings of the filer, kept verbatim.
